text: Assumption: Since PolymorphicAllocator merely references the MemoryResource as a pointer, the lifetime responsibility for the memory resource lies with the caller — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Since PolymorphicAllocator merely references the MemoryResource as a pointer, the lifetime responsibility for the memory resource lies with the caller — is this correct?
norm: since polymorphicallocator merely references the memoryresource as a pointer the lifetime responsibility for the memory resource lies with the caller
assumption: Since PolymorphicAllocator merely references the MemoryResource as a pointer, the lifetime responsibility for the memory resource lies with the caller.
rationale: The allocator possesses no transfer mechanism for the ownership of the resource (SWS_CORE_06542, SWS_CORE_06557).

original.text: Annahme: Da PolymorphicAllocator die MemoryResource lediglich als Zeiger referenziert, liegt die Lebensdauerverantwortung für die Speicherressource vermutlich beim Aufrufer — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Da PolymorphicAllocator die MemoryResource lediglich als Zeiger referenziert, liegt die Lebensdauerverantwortung für die Speicherressource vermutlich beim Aufrufer.
original.rationale: Der Allokator besitzt keinen Übergabemechanismus für den Besitz der Ressource (SWS_CORE_06542, SWS_CORE_06557).
